meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，你可以让Claude帮你操作Git历史，比如提交代码、合并提交、查看谁改了某行代码等。它会先检查仓库状态，然后按你的要求执行具体操作。
howto.when: 当你要求提交代码、查看代码历史、合并提交或做任何Git相关操作时触发。

say.text: 帮我提交这个文件，提交信息用前几次的格式。
say.note: Claude会将文件分步提交，并检测本地提交习惯。

say.text: 查一下这行是谁在什么时候写的。
say.note: Claude会用git blame查找该行最后修改者和提交。

howto.what_en: With this skill, you can ask Claude to handle Git operations like commits, rebase, squash, and history queries. It will inspect the repository state and carry out your requested Git tasks.
howto.when_en: It activates when you ask for any Git-related work, such as committing changes, investigating history, or rewriting commits.

say_en.text: Commit this file with the message style from recent commits.
say_en.note: Claude will stage the file and commit using the dominant local pattern.

say_en.text: Who last changed this line and when?
say_en.note: Claude uses git blame to find the commit and author.
